bio.text: Tom Stanten is a Republican candidate for New York State Senate District 26 in Brooklyn, according to his campaign website.
The site says he is a U.S. Navy veteran who deployed aboard the USS Carl Vinson and a retired NYPD Detective Investigator whose assignments included East New York and Southern Brooklyn.
According to the site, he owns a motorcycle shop in Sunset Park.
